text:
anna_prod: Quick internal availability notice: weve opened H100v2 Dedicated capacity in ap-southeast-2 (Sydney) across zones a/c and expanded L4m capacity in eu-west-3 (Paris) by adding an extra rack. This is meant for migration requests and new Dedicated reservations starting today.

devin_infra: Rollout summary: Sydney H100v2 = 16 GPUs total (8 per zone). Paris L4m = +12 GPUs (spread across zone a/c). Soft per-account caps: H100v2 = 4 GPUs/zone, L4m = 5 GPUs/zone. To request >soft-cap, submit quota request under "Dedicated GPU - H100v2" or "Dedicated GPU - L4m" and include projected tokens/sec and peak sequence length. Typical review 48-72h.

sylvia_sales: Any special handling for customers in trials or those moving from Hosted? Can AMs request temporary bump for 30d migrations?

anna_prod: Temporary migration bumps allowed but controlled: were introducing a new reservation_hold_type field with values ["preview","reserved","burstable"]. Preview = short-term migration assistance (max 30d), Burstable = up to 14d bursting with higher preemption risk. Finance will approve preview credits case-by-case. AMs, tag requests with "migration-preview" in the intake form.

infra-bot: Telemetry snapshot (ap-southeast-2/ eu-west-3): Sydney p95 token-latency 46ms p99 88ms avg gpu util 33%. Paris p95 50ms p99 85ms avg util 42%. No failed nodes; spare capacity ~26% in Sydney, ~18% in Paris.

omar_ops: Ops note: during staging we observed one H100v2 node with a transient NVLink error; node restarted and passed health checks. Vendor firmware update scheduled Tue 2026-04-14 02:00-03:00 UTC for the Sydney rack. We'll do rolling updates and prefer to migrate burstable/preview reservations first.

support-bot: Support reminder: include reservation_hold_type and quota request ID in tickets. Use tags "dedicated-syd-h100v2" and "dedicated-par-l4m" for faster routing. For preview requests include expected migration cutover date.

lucy_fin: Policy update: introducing early_cancel_fee_pct field for preview reservations. Preview cancellations within 7 days = no fee, 8-30 days = 8% early-release fee of monthly committed spend. Burstable reservations have a smaller refund model (prorated credits on preemption). We'll publish billing examples in the pricing doc.

devin_infra: API items: adding reservation_hold_type (string), early_cancel_fee_pct (int), and preemption_notice_mins (int) for burstable reservations. Also adding a new gauge to the console showing "spare GPUs by zone" and a pager if any zone drops below 12% spare.

sylvia_sales: I'll brief AMs and update deal templates. Any recommended language for customers worried about early_cancel fees?

anna_prod: Messaging: clarify that preview reservations are designed for migrations and that short cancellations (<7d) are fee-free. Production reservations should use "reserved" tier. Exceptions handled by partner-ops for strategic accounts.

omar_ops: Action items: (1) infra to push API changes and console gauge @devin_infra, (2) ops to publish maintenance/fallthrough playbook and schedule @omar_ops, (3) sales to log preview requests and customer consent @sylvia_sales, (4) finance to add billing examples to docs @lucy_fin.

devin_infra: Will ship API changes behind a feature flag today and enable dashboard tile tomorrow. Pager rules + preemption telemetry will follow.

anna_prod: We'll hold any external announcement until after the firmware window and 48h of stable telemetry. Thanks team :australia: :paris: Reply here with any blockers or urgent requests.
